title: Delegate with an explicit contract and disjoint file ownership
prompt: Split the expenses rework between two implementation agents.
expectedBehavior: Write one delegation contract per task: objective, scope, file ownership, context, restrictions, deliverables, verification owner
Claim disjoint paths with delegate.mjs before either agent edits
Let the lead agent integrate and run the final verification
Escalate conflicting findings to the lead instead of silently choosing
prohibitedBehavior: Two agents editing the same file without a recorded takeover decision
Spawning agents for a task one agent can finish
Delegating verification away from the lead agent
criteria: Every delegated task has an ownership claim
Overlapping claims are refused or explicitly taken over with a reason
The lead agent runs the final gate
